dict.string: Tonalli shares the books and maps you choose with devices on your Wi-Fi, only while sharing is on and only after you approve a pairing code.
Tonalli talks to your Meshtastic radio over Bluetooth, only after you choose a radio in Chat and only to read and send chat messages.
Tonalli shows where you are on an offline map, only when you tap the locate button. Your location stays on this iPhone and is never sent anywhere.
